tools.name: erp_get_production_plan
tools.description: Retrieve planned production runs (line, product, planned start/end, planned quantity) for a line and date range from the ERP production plan. Read-only. Used as the primary hard-constraint source for preventive maintenance scheduling windows.

tools.name: erp_get_plant_calendar
tools.description: Retrieve plant calendar day types (working day, shutdown, holiday) for a plant and date range from the ERP. Read-only. Shutdown days are surfaced as preferred high-availability PM windows.

tools.name: erp_get_cost_center
tools.description: Retrieve maintenance/spares cost center budget and actual spend for a period from the ERP. Read-only. Provisioned for service-account consistency across Maintenance use cases; not consumed by the current scheduling workflow.

tools.name: erp_get_staging_freshness
tools.description: Return the as-of timestamp of the most recently cached ERP production-plan/plant-calendar staging pull, so callers can enforce the 48-hour staleness guard before relying on cached data for automatic schedule publication. Read-only.
